name: Mount Monitor
author: jasonlnheath
description: A simple visualizer of hd usage that monitors when space gets too high, on any disk mount you configure (btrfs, NTFS, ext4, ...). At 98% or more it throws a notification and glows red. Notifications are configured to go to your agent of choice with a skill that suggests files to prune / compress, or what to move off a read-only mount. On first run it scans your partitions and asks which to monitor, and a partition that appears later notifies once.

barWidget.description: Usage ring per configured disk mount (btrfs, NTFS, ext4, ...); alerts at 80/90/98%; click a notification to have your agent run a cleanup analysis, or a move-off report for a read-only mount. First run and new partitions get a notice asking which ones to monitor.
